title: Pip Sees the Seed Grow
checkpoint: Phase 5 continues (School readiness) — new graphemes ore, oor, our.
note_for_grown_ups: Phase 5 continues (School readiness) — new graphemes ore, oor, our.

pages.text: Pip sets a seed in the soil.
pages.illustration: Pip the sparrow pressing a small seed down into dark soil inside the greenhouse.

pages.text: Pip checks on the seed each day.
pages.illustration: Pip the sparrow hopping up to peer closely at a small patch of bare soil in a plant pot.

pages.text: On day one, the soil looks the same.
pages.illustration: A plant pot with plain, flat soil and no sign of a shoot yet, Pip looking at it.

pages.text: On the next day, a small shoot peeps up.
pages.illustration: A tiny pale green shoot just breaking through the surface of the soil.

pages.text: Pip lets the shoot have a drink.
pages.illustration: Pip the sparrow tipping a tiny bit of water from a leaf onto the base of the small shoot.

pages.text: The shoot grows a bit each day.
pages.illustration: A sequence of the shoot looking slightly taller than before, still thin and pale green.

pages.text: The leaf grows wide and green.
pages.illustration: Broad green leaves unfurling and spreading out from the stem of the growing plant.

pages.text: A tight green bud forms on the top.
pages.illustration: A small, tightly closed green bud sitting at the very top of the plant stem.

pages.text: At last, the bloom is out and bright.
pages.illustration: The green bud opening into a bright, colourful bloom at the top of the plant.

pages.text: Pip is proud of the bloom in the sun.
pages.illustration: Pip the sparrow perched beside the greenhouse pot, looking proudly at the bright bloom glowing in the sunlight.
